description: PreToolUse hook latency budget. See docs/performance/hook-latency-budget.md. target_ms is the product objective on reference hardware (quiet 4-vCPU Linux or Windows 11 with Defender, Node 22+); p95_ms is the regression gate of scripts/benchmarks/hook-latency.mjs --budget-file; ci_p95_ms is the gate of the vitest latency test, deliberately generous for shared, loaded CI runners.
